title: Integration test: pin/unpin/GC round-trip with audit verification
description:
Integration test: store 20 articles, apply a pinning policy that pins 7 of them, run GC, verify 13 are unpinned, verify 7 remain pinned, verify audit log has exactly 13 records. Then update policy to pin all 20, run GC, verify no further unpins. Artifact: transit/tests/retention_roundtrip.rs.

Acceptance:
- Test is deterministic and runs headlessly
- Audit log contains correct count of records after each GC run
- IPFS mock or embedded IPFS node used (no external dependency)
- Test completes in under 30 seconds
